answer_1.quote: As generative language models, LLMs should be evaluated not only on classification-style (e.g., MCQA) WSD tasks, but also on their ability to generate highquality sense definitions... We propose DGQS which assesses definition generation quality.
answer_1.outputs: Generated sense definitions for polysemous words

answer_2.quote: We also report typical generative metrics such as BLEU, ROUGE-1, ROUGE-2, ROUGE-L, relaxed matching F1, and the proposed Definition Generation Quality Score (DGQS).

answer_4.quote: We also conduct human evaluations of these output, and only one instance from SemEval2015 is exact match.
answer_4.guideline: Human annotators checked whether the generated definitions exactly matched the gold-standard definitions.
